```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)

# Load and tidy Dataset 1: Pre-competition weight cut & fight-day rebound (32 athletes)
weight_cut <- read_excel("data/weight_cut_mma.xlsx", sheet = 1) |>
  slice(c(38, 39, 40, 41, 45)) |>
  mutate(metric = c("start_weight_kg", "weighin_weight_kg", "fight_weight_kg", "height_m", "result_code")) |>
  select(-atletas) |>
  pivot_longer(-metric, names_to = "athlete_id", values_to = "value") |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = metric, values_from = value) |>
  drop_na(fight_weight_kg) |>
  mutate(
    pct_weight_cut = (start_weight_kg - weighin_weight_kg) / start_weight_kg * 100,
    pct_rebound = (fight_weight_kg - weighin_weight_kg) / weighin_weight_kg * 100,
    outcome = case_when(
      result_code == 1 ~ "Win",
      result_code == 2 ~ "Loss",
      result_code == 3 ~ "Draw / No Contest"
    )
  )

# Load and tidy Dataset 2: Wrestler longitudinal weight, body fat %, HRV, and heart rate (20 wrestlers)
wrestler_anthro <- read_csv("data/wrestler_anthro.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  filter(!is.na(Boy)) |>
  transmute(
    wrestler_id = row_number(),
    height_cm = Boy,
    age = Yas,
    weight_detraining_kg = VA1,
    weight_comp_kg = VA5,
    bodyfat_detraining_pct = Yag1,
    bodyfat_comp_pct = Yag5
  )

wrestler_hrv <- read_csv("data/wrestler_hrv.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  transmute(
    wrestler_id = row_number(),
    hrv_detraining = DetrHRV,
    hrv_comp = `MüsabakaHRV`,
    hr_detraining = DetrainingHR,
    hr_comp = `MüsabakaHR`
  )

wrestler_tracking <- left_join(wrestler_anthro, wrestler_hrv, by = "wrestler_id")

# Load and tidy Dataset 3: Elite combat sports body composition (68 athletes)
combat_body_comp <- read_excel("data/combat_body_comp.xlsx", sheet = 1, .name_repair = "minimal") |>
  select(1:16) |>
  set_names(c(
    "sport_code", "age", "weight_kg", "height_cm",
    "triceps_mm", "subscapular_mm", "biceps_mm", "iliac_crest_mm",
    "supraspinale_mm", "abdominal_mm", "mid_thigh_mm", "calf_mm",
    "arm_relaxed_cm", "arm_flexed_cm", "waist_cm", "hip_cm"
  ))
```

```{r}
# Plot pre-competition weight cut (%) vs. fight-day rebound (%) by match outcome
ggplot(weight_cut, aes(x = pct_weight_cut, y = pct_rebound, color = outcome)) +
  geom_smooth(aes(group = 1), method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "gray60", linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.85) +
  labs(
    title = "Pre-Competition Weight Cut vs. Fight-Day Rehydration Rebound",
    subtitle = "Combat athletes almost completely rebound the percentage of body mass lost before weigh-ins",
    x = "Weight Cut Before Weigh-In (% of Starting Body Mass)",
    y = "Weight Rebound by Fight Day (% of Weigh-In Mass)",
    color = "Match Outcome",
    caption = "Source: Prospective Interventional Study of Pre-Competition Weight Management (Figshare)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
